SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT canonical_events.event_id AS event_id, canonical_events.competition AS competition, canonical_events.team_a_id AS team_a_id, canonical_events.team_a AS team_a, canonical_events.team_b_id AS team_b_id, canonical_events.team_b AS team_b, canonical_events.starts_at AS starts_at, canonical_events.best_of AS best_of, canonical_events.observed_at AS observed_at 
FROM (SELECT core.series.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_3)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_4)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_5)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_6)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(series_starts.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_1)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.series.scheduled_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, greatest(%(greatest_1)s::INTEGER, least(coalesce(core.series.best_of, %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER), %(least_1)s::INTEGER)) AS best_of, core.series.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.series LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.series.competition_id JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = core.series.team_one_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = core.series.team_two_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT core.games.series_id AS series_id, min(core.games.start_at) AS start_at 
FROM core.games 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY core.games.series_id) AS series_starts ON series_starts.series_id = core.series.id UNION ALL SELECT core.games.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_7)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_8)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_9)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_10)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(core.games.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_2)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.games.event_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, %(param_1)s::INTEGER AS best_of, core.games.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.games LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.games.competition_id JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_blue ON event_blue.game_id = core.games.id AND event_blue.side = %(side_1)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_red ON event_red.game_id = core.games.id AND event_red.side = %(side_2)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = event_blue.team_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = event_red.team_id 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NULL) AS canonical_events) AS anon_1

SELECT canonical_events.event_id, canonical_events.competition, canonical_events.team_a_id, canonical_events.team_a, canonical_events.team_b_id, canonical_events.team_b, canonical_events.starts_at, canonical_events.best_of, canonical_events.observed_at 
FROM (SELECT core.series.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_3)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_4)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_5)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_6)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(series_starts.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_1)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.series.scheduled_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, greatest(%(greatest_1)s::INTEGER, least(coalesce(core.series.best_of, %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER), %(least_1)s::INTEGER)) AS best_of, core.series.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.series LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.series.competition_id JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = core.series.team_one_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = core.series.team_two_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT core.games.series_id AS series_id, min(core.games.start_at) AS start_at 
FROM core.games 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY core.games.series_id) AS series_starts ON series_starts.series_id = core.series.id UNION ALL SELECT core.games.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_7)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_8)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_9)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_10)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(core.games.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_2)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.games.event_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, %(param_1)s::INTEGER AS best_of, core.games.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.games LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.games.competition_id JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_blue ON event_blue.game_id = core.games.id AND event_blue.side = %(side_1)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_red ON event_red.game_id = core.games.id AND event_red.side = %(side_2)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = event_blue.team_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = event_red.team_id 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NULL) AS canonical_events ORDER BY canonical_events.starts_at DESC, canonical_events.event_id DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_2)s::INTEGER OFFSET %(param_3)s::INTEGER

FROM signals.signals JOIN odds.snapshots ON odds.snapshots.id = signals.signals.odds_snapshot_id JOIN odds.providers ON odds.providers.id = odds.snapshots.provider_id JOIN odds.markets ON odds.markets.id = odds.snapshots.market_id JOIN ml.prematch_predictions ON ml.prematch_predictions.id = signals.signals.prediction_id JOIN ml.model_versions ON ml.model_versions.id = ml.prematch_predictions.model_version_id JOIN core.teams ON core.teams.id = signals.signals.selected_team_id JOIN (SELECT core.series.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_3)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_4)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_5)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_6)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(series_starts.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_1)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.series.scheduled_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, greatest(%(greatest_1)s::INTEGER, least(coalesce(core.series.best_of, %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER), %(least_1)s::INTEGER)) AS best_of, core.series.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.series LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.series.competition_id JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = core.series.team_one_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = core.series.team_two_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT core.games.series_id AS series_id, min(core.games.start_at) AS start_at 
FROM core.games 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY core.games.series_id) AS series_starts ON series_starts.series_id = core.series.id UNION ALL SELECT core.games.id AS event_id, coalesce(coalesce(nullif(core.competitions.display_name, %(nullif_1)s::VARCHAR), nullif(core.competitions.normalized_name, %(nullif_2)s::VARCHAR), core.competitions.source_competition_id), %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) AS competition, event_a.id AS team_a_id, coalesce(nullif(event_a.display_name, %(nullif_7)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_a.normalized_name, %(nullif_8)s::VARCHAR), event_a.source_team_id) AS team_a, event_b.id AS team_b_id, coalesce(nullif(event_b.display_name, %(nullif_9)s::VARCHAR), nullif(event_b.normalized_name, %(nullif_10)s::VARCHAR), event_b.source_team_id) AS team_b, coalesce(core.games.start_at, timezone(%(timezone_2)s::VARCHAR, CAST(core.games.event_date AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE))) AS starts_at, %(param_1)s::INTEGER AS best_of, core.games.processed_at AS observed_at 
FROM core.games LEFT OUTER JOIN core.competitions ON core.competitions.id = core.games.competition_id JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_blue ON event_blue.game_id = core.games.id AND event_blue.side = %(side_1)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.game_team_stats AS event_red ON event_red.game_id = core.games.id AND event_red.side = %(side_2)s::VARCHAR JOIN core.teams AS event_a ON event_a.id = event_blue.team_id JOIN core.teams AS event_b ON event_b.id = event_red.team_id 
WHERE core.games.series_id IS NULL) AS canonical_events ON canonical_events.event_id = ml.prematch_predictions.event_id 
WHERE signals.signals.value_computed IS true AND signals.signals.fair_odds IS NOT NULL AND ml.prematch_predictions.data_coverage IS NOT NULL AND ml.prematch_predictions.out_of_distribution_distance IS NOT NULL AND odds.snapshots.captured_at IS NOT NULL) AS opportunity_rows

 LIMIT %(param_2)s::INTEGER OFFSET %(param_3)s::INTEGER

FROM (SELECT raw.quality_issues.id AS id, raw.quality_issues.created_at AS observed_at, CASE WHEN (raw.quality_issues.severity = %(severity_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_1)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_2)s::VARCHAR END AS severity, CASE WHEN (raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_4)s::VARCHAR END AS status, jsonb_build_object(%(jsonb_build_object_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.id, %(jsonb_build_object_2)s::VARCHAR, concat(%(concat_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.source_catalog.season_year), %(jsonb_build_object_3)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.code, %(jsonb_build_object_4)s::VARCHAR, CASE WHEN (raw.quality_issues.severity = %(severity_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_1)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_2)s::VARCHAR END, %(jsonb_build_object_5)s::VARCHAR, CASE WHEN (raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_4)s::VARCHAR END, %(jsonb_build_object_6)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.message, %(jsonb_build_object_7)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.created_at, %(jsonb_build_object_8)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_9)s::VARCHAR) AS document 
FROM raw.quality_issues JOIN raw.ingestion_runs ON raw.quality_issues.run_id = raw.ingestion_runs.id JOIN raw.source_catalog ON raw.ingestion_runs.source_catalog_id = raw.source_catalog.id LEFT OUTER JOIN raw.snapshots ON raw.quality_issues.snapshot_id = raw.snapshots.id 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.provider = %(provider_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.dataset = %(dataset_1)s::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT raw.quarantine_items.id AS id, raw.quarantine_items.quarantined_at AS observed_at, %(param_5)s::VARCHAR AS severity, %(param_6)s::VARCHAR AS status, jsonb_build_object(%(jsonb_build_object_10)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.id, %(jsonb_build_object_11)s::VARCHAR, concat(%(concat_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.source_catalog.season_year), %(jsonb_build_object_12)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.reason_code, %(jsonb_build_object_13)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_14)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_15)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_16)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_17)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_18)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_19)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.quarantined_at, %(jsonb_build_object_20)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_21)s::VARCHAR) AS document 
FROM raw.quarantine_items JOIN raw.snapshots ON raw.quarantine_items.snapshot_id = raw.snapshots.id JOIN raw.source_catalog ON raw.snapshots.source_catalog_id = raw.source_catalog.id 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.provider = %(provider_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.dataset = %(dataset_1)s::VARCHAR) AS quality_entries) AS anon_1

SELECT quality_entries.id, quality_entries.observed_at, quality_entries.severity, quality_entries.status, quality_entries.document 
FROM (SELECT raw.quality_issues.id AS id, raw.quality_issues.created_at AS observed_at, CASE WHEN (raw.quality_issues.severity = %(severity_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_1)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_2)s::VARCHAR END AS severity, CASE WHEN (raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_4)s::VARCHAR END AS status, jsonb_build_object(%(jsonb_build_object_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.id, %(jsonb_build_object_2)s::VARCHAR, concat(%(concat_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.source_catalog.season_year), %(jsonb_build_object_3)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.code, %(jsonb_build_object_4)s::VARCHAR, CASE WHEN (raw.quality_issues.severity = %(severity_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_1)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_2)s::VARCHAR END, %(jsonb_build_object_5)s::VARCHAR, CASE WHEN (raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_4)s::VARCHAR END, %(jsonb_build_object_6)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.message, %(jsonb_build_object_7)s::VARCHAR, raw.quality_issues.created_at, %(jsonb_build_object_8)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_9)s::VARCHAR) AS document 
FROM raw.quality_issues JOIN raw.ingestion_runs ON raw.quality_issues.run_id = raw.ingestion_runs.id JOIN raw.source_catalog ON raw.ingestion_runs.source_catalog_id = raw.source_catalog.id LEFT OUTER JOIN raw.snapshots ON raw.quality_issues.snapshot_id = raw.snapshots.id 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.provider = %(provider_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.dataset = %(dataset_1)s::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT raw.quarantine_items.id AS id, raw.quarantine_items.quarantined_at AS observed_at, %(param_5)s::VARCHAR AS severity, %(param_6)s::VARCHAR AS status, jsonb_build_object(%(jsonb_build_object_10)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.id, %(jsonb_build_object_11)s::VARCHAR, concat(%(concat_1)s::VARCHAR, raw.source_catalog.season_year), %(jsonb_build_object_12)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.reason_code, %(jsonb_build_object_13)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_14)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_15)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_16)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_17)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_18)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_19)s::VARCHAR, raw.quarantine_items.quarantined_at, %(jsonb_build_object_20)s::VARCHAR, %(jsonb_build_object_21)s::VARCHAR) AS document 
FROM raw.quarantine_items JOIN raw.snapshots ON raw.quarantine_items.snapshot_id = raw.snapshots.id JOIN raw.source_catalog ON raw.snapshots.source_catalog_id = raw.source_catalog.id 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.provider = %(provider_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.dataset = %(dataset_1)s::VARCHAR) AS quality_entries ORDER BY quality_entries.observed_at DESC, quality_entries.id DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_7)s::INTEGER OFFSET %(param_8)s::INTEGER

WITH entries AS (
    SELECT id, coalesce(started_at, created_at) AS sort_at, jsonb_build_object(
      'jobId', id, 'name', job_type, 'status', status,
      'lastRunAt', coalesce(finished_at, started_at),
      'dataMode', 'real', 'scope', scope, 'attempt', attempt, 'maxAttempts', max_attempts,
      'scheduledAt', scheduled_at, 'heartbeatAt', heartbeat_at, 'leaseExpiresAt', lease_expires_at,
      'errorCode', error_code, 'cancelRequested', cancel_requested, 'traceId', trace_id,
      'runId', result->>'runId'
    ) AS document FROM ops.jobs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, updated_at, jsonb_build_object('jobId', id, 'name', name, 'status', status,
      'lastRunAt', coalesce(finished_at, updated_at), 'dataMode', 'real') FROM ml.model_action_jobs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, updated_at, jsonb_build_object('jobId', id,
      'name', concat('oe-backfill-', from_year, '-', to_year), 'status', status,
      'lastRunAt', coalesce(finished_at, updated_at), 'dataMode', 'real') FROM raw.backfill_jobs
), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM entries WHERE CAST(%(status)s AS text) IS NULL OR document->>'status' = %(status)s) SELECT count(*) FROM filtered

    SELECT id, coalesce(started_at, created_at) AS sort_at, jsonb_build_object(
      'jobId', id, 'name', job_type, 'status', status,
      'lastRunAt', coalesce(finished_at, started_at),
      'dataMode', 'real', 'scope', scope, 'attempt', attempt, 'maxAttempts', max_attempts,

      'errorCode', error_code, 'cancelRequested', cancel_requested, 'traceId', trace_id,

    ) AS document FROM ops.jobs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, updated_at, jsonb_build_object('jobId', id, 'name', name, 'status', status,
      'lastRunAt', coalesce(finished_at, updated_at), 'dataMode', 'real') FROM ml.model_action_jobs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, updated_at, jsonb_build_object('jobId', id,

WITH entries AS (
    SELECT a.id, coalesce(m.occurred_at, r.occurred_at, a.occurred_at) AS sort_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'auditId', coalesce(m.id, r.id, a.id), 'action', coalesce(m.action, r.action, a.action),
      'resourceId', coalesce(m.resource_id, r.resource_id, a.target_id),
      'idempotencyFingerprint', coalesce(a.after_refs->>'idempotency_fingerprint',
        encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')),
      'occurredAt', coalesce(m.occurred_at, r.occurred_at, a.occurred_at),
      'dataMode', 'real', 'actor', a.actor, 'reason', r.reason,
      'impact', coalesce(r.impact, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'traceId', a.trace_id, 'targetType', a.target_type,
        'beforeRefs', a.before_refs, 'afterRefs', a.after_refs, 'recordedAt', a.occurred_at)
    ) AS document FROM ops.audit_events a
    LEFT JOIN ml.model_action_audits m ON a.target_type = 'ml.model_action_audits'
      AND a.target_id = m.id::text
    LEFT JOIN odds.mapping_audits r ON a.target_type = 'odds.mapping_audits'
      AND a.target_id = r.id::text
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.id, m.occurred_at, jsonb_build_object('auditId', m.id, 'action', m.action,
      'resourceId', m.resource_id, 'idempotencyFingerprint', m.idempotency_fingerprint,
      'occurredAt', m.occurred_at, 'dataMode', 'real') FROM ml.model_action_audits m
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.audit_events a
      WHERE a.target_type = 'ml.model_action_audits' AND a.target_id = m.id::text)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.id, r.occurred_at, jsonb_build_object('auditId', r.id, 'action', r.action,
      'resourceId', r.resource_id, 'idempotencyFingerprint', r.idempotency_fingerprint,
      'occurredAt', r.occurred_at, 'dataMode', 'real', 'actor', r.actor, 'reason', r.reason,
      'impact', r.impact) FROM odds.mapping_audits r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.audit_events a
      WHERE a.target_type = 'odds.mapping_audits' AND a.target_id = r.id::text)
), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM entries WHERE CAST(%(status)s AS text) IS NULL OR document->>'status' = %(status)s) SELECT count(*) FROM filtered

WITH entries AS (
    SELECT a.id, coalesce(m.occurred_at, r.occurred_at, a.occurred_at) AS sort_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'auditId', coalesce(m.id, r.id, a.id), 'action', coalesce(m.action, r.action, a.action),
      'resourceId', coalesce(m.resource_id, r.resource_id, a.target_id),
      'idempotencyFingerprint', coalesce(a.after_refs->>'idempotency_fingerprint',
        encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')),
      'occurredAt', coalesce(m.occurred_at, r.occurred_at, a.occurred_at),
      'dataMode', 'real', 'actor', a.actor, 'reason', r.reason,
      'impact', coalesce(r.impact, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'traceId', a.trace_id, 'targetType', a.target_type,
        'beforeRefs', a.before_refs, 'afterRefs', a.after_refs, 'recordedAt', a.occurred_at)
    ) AS document FROM ops.audit_events a
    LEFT JOIN ml.model_action_audits m ON a.target_type = 'ml.model_action_audits'
      AND a.target_id = m.id::text
    LEFT JOIN odds.mapping_audits r ON a.target_type = 'odds.mapping_audits'
      AND a.target_id = r.id::text
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.id, m.occurred_at, jsonb_build_object('auditId', m.id, 'action', m.action,
      'resourceId', m.resource_id, 'idempotencyFingerprint', m.idempotency_fingerprint,
      'occurredAt', m.occurred_at, 'dataMode', 'real') FROM ml.model_action_audits m
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.audit_events a
      WHERE a.target_type = 'ml.model_action_audits' AND a.target_id = m.id::text)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.id, r.occurred_at, jsonb_build_object('auditId', r.id, 'action', r.action,
      'resourceId', r.resource_id, 'idempotencyFingerprint', r.idempotency_fingerprint,
      'occurredAt', r.occurred_at, 'dataMode', 'real', 'actor', r.actor, 'reason', r.reason,

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.audit_events a
      WHERE a.target_type = 'odds.mapping_audits' AND a.target_id = r.id::text)
), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM entries WHERE CAST(%(status)s AS text) IS NULL OR document->>'status' = %(status)s) SELECT document FROM filtered ORDER BY sort_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(offset)s

SELECT raw.source_catalog.id 
FROM raw.source_catalog 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.provider = %(provider_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.dataset = %(dataset_1)s::VARCHAR AND raw.source_catalog.season_year = %(season_year_1)s::INTEGER ORDER BY raw.source_catalog.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR DESC, raw.source_catalog.updated_at DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT raw.source_catalog.status, raw.source_catalog.current_snapshot_id 
FROM raw.source_catalog 
WHERE raw.source_catalog.id = %(id_1)s::UUID

SELECT raw.snapshots.id, raw.snapshots.validated_at 
FROM raw.snapshots 
WHERE raw.snapshots.id = %(id_1)s::UUID AND raw.snapshots.source_catalog_id = %(source_catalog_id_1)s::UUID AND raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT max(raw.ingestion_runs.finished_at) AS max_1 
FROM raw.ingestion_runs 
WHERE raw.ingestion_runs.source_catalog_id = %(source_catalog_id_1)s::UUID AND raw.ingestion_runs.snapshot_id = %(snapshot_id_1)s::UUID AND raw.ingestion_runs.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND (raw.ingestion_runs.counters ->> %(counters_1)s::TEXT) = %(param_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT raw.snapshots.received_at 
FROM raw.snapshots 
WHERE raw.snapshots.source_catalog_id = %(source_catalog_id_1)s::UUID AND raw.snapshots.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY raw.snapshots.received_at DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT raw.ingestion_runs.finished_at, raw.ingestion_runs.error_code 
FROM raw.ingestion_runs 
WHERE raw.ingestion_runs.source_catalog_id = %(source_catalog_id_1)s::UUID AND raw.ingestion_runs.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY raw.ingestion_runs.finished_at DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER
SELECT id, registered_at, training_cutoff_max FROM ml.model_versions WHERE status = 'champion' AND game = 'lol' AND market = 'game_winner' AND segment = 'global' ORDER BY registered_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status, count(*) FROM ops.jobs GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)) AS mean FROM ops.jobs WHERE finished_at >= started_at
SELECT coalesce(sum((counters->>'total')::bigint), 0) FROM raw.ingestion_runs WHERE run_kind = 'load' AND status = 'succeeded' AND jsonb_typeof(counters->'total') = 'number'
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'blocking') AS blocking FROM raw.quality_issues
SELECT grade, count(*) FROM signals.signals GROUP BY grade
SELECT count(*) FROM odds.mapping_reviews WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT ops.backup_runs.finished_at, ops.backup_runs.started_at 
FROM ops.backup_runs 
WHERE ops.backup_runs.repository_fingerprint = %(repository_fingerprint_1)s::VARCHAR AND ops.backup_runs.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND ops.backup_runs.retained IS true ORDER BY ops.backup_runs.finished_at DESC, ops.backup_runs.started_at DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT ops.backup_runs.finished_at, ops.backup_runs.started_at, ops.backup_runs.error_code 
FROM ops.backup_runs 
WHERE ops.backup_runs.repository_fingerprint = %(repository_fingerprint_1)s::VARCHAR AND ops.backup_runs.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY ops.backup_runs.finished_at DESC, ops.backup_runs.started_at DESC, ops.backup_runs.id DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT ops.backup_runs.id 
FROM ops.backup_runs 
WHERE ops.backup_runs.repository_fingerprint = %(repository_fingerprint_1)s::VARCHAR AND ops.backup_runs.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND ops.backup_runs.started_at < %(started_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER
